SensitiveDetection.//: Nudity and graphic content checks with the CLIP model. The setup downloads it and sets ModelPath.

Email.//: Log (the default) writes emails to the console instead of sending them. For live values see

SendGrid.ApiKey: <only if Provider is SendGrid: a key with the Mail Send permission>

SMS.//: Log (the default) writes texts to the console instead of sending them.

Captcha.//: Cloudflare's public test secret, which accepts every token (the public report form sends X-Captcha-Token).

Reels.//: Daily reel plays per UK day: logged out and Free (Premium is unlimited). ViewerKeySecret hashes logged-out viewers' ids and IP addresses (secret: any long random string; a container secret when deployed). See bjk-modules README, Reels.

Heatmap.//: Cells with fewer than MinCellCount incidents are hidden. History in days by plan.

Plans.//: Billing isn't built: until the identity server issues the plan claim, give test accounts a plan here (user id -> free | premium | premium_plus).

Safety.//: Local development only: true (the default) needs the identity server's age_verified claim on writes.

Notifications.//: The web app's address, for the links in notification emails (passenger tags and so on). Optional.

Messaging.//: Optional; defaults shown. The queues are tables in the messaging schema of AppDatabase (see docs/messaging.md).
